description: Potential NULL dereference or use-after-free: Pipeline->Elements is accessed without checking if Pipeline or Elements is NULL. This can cause address sanitizer-detectable bugs such as invalid memory access.
reachability_reason: WriteInputLUT directly calls EmitCIEBasedDEF and is reachable from cms_postscript_fuzzer through cmsGetPostScriptCSA/CRD.
pov_guidance: Provide an ICC profile crafted so that after duplication and `_cmsOptimizePipeline` with `cmsFLAGS_FORCE_CLUT` all stages are removed, resulting in a pipeline with `Elements == NULL`.  This should trigger a NULL-pointer dereference in EmitCIEBasedDEF.
